is_victim.description: Apply these rules to the full dataset to create the initial sample of all identity theft victims (both attempted and successful). A record is a victim if ANY of the following conditions are met.

successful_thefts_only.description: Apply these rules to the dataset after merging but before final output to exclude records of 'attempted only' identity theft and retain only 'successful' incidents.

logic_by_year.2008: A record is considered 'Attempted Only' and should be DROPPED if VS012=2 AND VS014=2 AND VS016=2 AND VS018=2 AND VS020=2. All other victim records are successful.
logic_by_year.2012: A record is considered 'Attempted Only' and should be DROPPED if VS098 has a value of '009' (Not applicable, it was not actually used).
logic_by_year.2014: A record is considered 'Attempted Only' and should be DROPPED if VS093 has a value of '009' (Not applicable, it was not actually used).
logic_by_year.2016: A record is considered 'Attempted Only' and should be DROPPED if VS093 has a value of '9' (Not applicable, it was not actually misused).
logic_by_year.2018: A record is considered 'Attempted Only' and should be DROPPED if VS093 has a value of '9' (Not applicable, it was not actually misused).
logic_by_year.2021: No filtering action is needed. The survey questions for this year were designed to capture only successful incidents, so all victim records can be considered successful.
